text: {"lessons":["The portfolio has risen overall despite sizeable monthly swings, so I should stay focused on long-term goals rather than chase short-term moves.","Because I made no trades, I should still review whether each position and my cash allocation fit my plan instead of assuming inaction is always best.","I should judge each holding on its current merits and be willing to sell when warranted, regardless of its average cost or whether selling feels like admitting a mistake."]}
